build.walk_rule: 8-direction straight-line raster walk, corner cutting forbidden, x wraps mod 4320; per-segment passability is a hard build error
build.spoke_rule: one spoke per port: walk-aware lane rule — the first in-radius (Chebyshev 40, wrap-aware; ties smallest (y, x), then lane file order, then waypoint index) lane waypoint whose straight walk succeeds, else the passable direct walk to the national capital, else the tools/route_overrides.json spoke (A*-pathfound), else for a neutral port the nearest lane waypoint unbounded (A*); a port with none is a hard error; an override is superseded exactly when the lane rule succeeds
build.junction_rule: node = tile shared by >= 2 distinct paths or a path endpoint, keyed (x mod 4320, y); each path splits at its nodes into edges weighted by tile steps
build.month_rule: per lane and month 1..12 the active path (a variant whose months contain the month, else the base waypoints) must walk with that month's seasonal-ice mask active (data/ice_regions.json polygons; §4.14, §4.18); variant paths are carried per lane for the runtime's in-month selection and do not join the junction graph
